question: Within the frozen Droid task suite, does the cache-stable tune reduce observed resource use without reducing first-pass yield relative to native Droid?
pinnedModel: Droid Core route observed in each paired trial
decisionRule: Recommend cache-stable-droid only if paired confirmatory first-pass yield is not lower and observed Factory Standard Credits per verified task are lower; report all exclusions and per-task deltas.
limitations: Factory credits are reported in their observed billing unit; no USD conversion is inferred. Pilot runs cannot satisfy this claim.
